source_of_truth: Read by hand in app/components/Prices.vue: the computed getter at line 9 (`const converted = computed(() => { refreshRate(); return rate.value * 100 })`) calls refreshRate(), defined at lines 4-6, which performs I/O via `$fetch('/api/rate')`. A computed must be a pure derivation; this one triggers a network call on every re-evaluation, so it is a genuine computed-side-effect defect. Deriving this requires FOLLOWING the call from the getter into refreshRate's body — context the static detector lacks, since it inspects only the getter's own body with a balanced-brace scan and matches fetch/$fetch/emit/storage/DOM/router tokens there. The getter body contains only `refreshRate()`, no such token, so a correct full-context auditor would flag computed-side-effect at line 9 while the real tool is expected to MISS it (a false negative driven by insufficient context, not a truth error).

expected.rationale: the computed getter calls refreshRate(), whose body does `$fetch('/api/rate')`; the computed performs I/O on every re-evaluation, which is the defect. Heuristic is the honest level (static analysis cannot confirm the call always runs the fetch), matching how perf-audit reports a direct in-getter effect; here it is expected to surface as a false negative because the effect is one call-level deeper than the getter body the tool reads.
